entities.name: Aliban's Towers
entities.description: Door-less spires on Ulgrotha made by a goblin spell that makes rocks grow beneath one's feet.

entities.name: Aliban
entities.description: Legendary goblin wizard after whom the towers are named.

entities.name: Eron
entities.description: Taught the tower spell to the inhabitants of Aysen as a show of goodwill.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Land whose citizens built cobblestone roads using the spell.

entities.name: Koskun Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where some towers still stand.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Nearly camped among the towers with Sandruu before being ambushed by a Root Spider.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: Nearly camped among the towers with Feroz.

entities.name: Root Spider
entities.description: Creature that ambushed Feroz and Sandruu.

events.summary: Eron teaches the tower spell to the inhabitants of Aysen as a show of goodwill, and they use it to build their roads.
events.quote: The spell needed to create them has been taught to the inhabitants of Aysen as a show of goodwill by Eron .

events.summary: Feroz and Sandruu nearly camp among the towers before being ambushed by a Root Spider.
events.quote: Feroz and Sandruu nearly camped among them one night before being ambushed by a Root Spider .

relations.note: Named after the legendary goblin wizard.
relations.quote: They were named after the legendary goblin wizard Aliban .
